EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, WAL, FORMAT JSON)
            -- Retrying preserves identity while resetting only still-terminal receipts.
            UPDATE inbox_receipts
            SET
                attempts = 0,
                dead_at = NULL,
                dead_reason = NULL,
                last_error = NULL
            WHERE id = ANY($1)
              AND dead_at IS NOT NULL
            RETURNING
                id AS "id!"
